commit.message:
feat: initial public release v0.1.0

TopoRetarget: interaction-preserving retargeting of human hand-object
motion to the Wuji Hand 2, solved frame by frame as a QP over an
interaction mesh, with dataset importers, a viewer, batch runs and a
wuji-mjlab pen-spin clip converter.
